entries.title: Romans 10:1
segments: Brothers, my heart's desire and prayer to God for my People is for their Salvation.

entries.title: Romans 10:2
segments: I can testify that they are zealous for the honor of God; but they are not guided by true insight,

entries.title: Romans 10:3
segments: For, in their ignorance of the Divine Righteousness, and in their eagerness to set up a righteousness of their own, they refused to accept with submission the Divine Righteousness.

entries.title: Romans 10:4
segments: For Christ has brought Law to an end, so that righteousness may be obtained by every one who believes in him.

entries.title: Romans 10:5
segments: For Moses writes that, as for the righteousness which results from Law, 'those who practice it will find Life through it.'

entries.title: Romans 10:6
segments: But the righteousness which results from faith finds expression in these words--'Do not say to yourself "Who will go up into heaven?"'--which means to bring Christ down--'

entries.title: Romans 10:7
segments: Or "Who will go down into the depths below?"'--which means to bring Christ up from the dead.

entries.title: Romans 10:8
segments: No, but what does it say? 'The Message of Faith' which we proclaim.

entries.title: Romans 10:9
segments: For, if with your lips you acknowledge the truth of the Message that JESUS IS LORD, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you shall be saved.

entries.title: Romans 10:10
segments: For with their hearts men believe and so attain to righteousness, while with their lips they make their Profession of Faith and so find Salvation.

entries.title: Romans 10:11
segments: As the passage of Scripture says--'No one who believes in him shall have any cause for shame.'

entries.title: Romans 10:12
segments: For no distinction is made between the Jew and the Greek, for all have the same Lord, and he is bountiful to all who invoke him.

entries.title: Romans 10:13
segments: For 'every one who invokes the Name of the Lord shall be saved.'

entries.title: Romans 10:14
segments: But how, it may be asked, are they to invoke one in whom they have not learned to believe? And how are they to believe in one whose words they have not heard? And how are they to hear his words unless some one proclaims him?

entries.title: Romans 10:15
segments: And how are men to proclaim him unless they are sent as his messengers? As Scripture says--'How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!'

entries.title: Romans 10:16
segments: Still, it may be said, every one did not give heed to the Good News. No, for Isaiah asks--'Lord, who has believed our teaching?'

entries.title: Romans 10:17
segments: And so we gather, faith is a result of teaching, and the teaching comes in the Message of Christ.

entries.title: Romans 10:18
segments: But I ask 'Is it possible that men have never heard?' No, indeed, for--'Their voices spread through all the earth, and their Message to the very ends of the world.'

entries.title: Romans 10:19
segments: But again I ask 'Did not the people of Israel understand? First there is Moses, who says--'I, the Lord, will stir you to rivalry with a nation which is no nation; Against an undiscerning nation I will arouse your anger.'

entries.title: Romans 10:20
segments: And Isaiah says boldly--'I was found by those who were not seeking me; I made myself known to those who were not inquiring of me.

entries.title: Romans 10:21
segments: But of the people of Israel he says--'All day long I have stretched out my hands to a people who disobey and contradict.'
